capabilities: Renders interactive Plotly charts from YAML or JSON plotly code blocks
Fits chart width to the note and to PDF export pages
Explores CSV and Markdown table data with read-only eda tools
Builds, checks and reads chart blocks through agent tools
Records data provenance in chart block comments
extras: Agent tools are read-only and exposed via agentinterop v1, the author's own MCP-like convention, not an official standard; CSV tools accept at most 100 columns, 100,000 rows and 5 MiB; the plugin works without any agent, and the community-list install path applies only once it is listed.
intentEvidence: It is a fork of obsidian-plotly by Dmitriy Shulha (MIT), updated to Plotly.js 4 and D3 7.
problem: Obsidian cannot render interactive Plotly charts from plain code blocks, and LLM agents have no validated way to turn vault data into chart blocks.
